# Vendored frontend assets

Bootstrap 5.3.3 CSS (MIT) and Font Awesome Free 6.5.1 CSS plus its referenced fonts
(CSS: MIT; fonts: SIL OFL 1.1; icons: CC BY 4.0) are served from this directory.
The original license files are included. No browser CDN access is required.

The CSS files are unmodified and were verified against the existing HTML's SHA-384
SRI values before being saved. The Bootstrap source map is also local.
The manifest records source URLs and SHA-256 hashes for every downloaded file.
Source URLs document provenance; they are not runtime dependencies.
